sql.list:
WITH visible AS (
  SELECT statement_id, statement_type, title, message, policy_code, status, created_at, updated_at
  FROM n_account_statements
  WHERE user_id = :user_id AND (:status IS NULL OR status = :status)
    AND (:statement_type IS NULL OR statement_type = :statement_type)
), ranked AS (
  SELECT visible.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY created_at DESC, statement_id DESC) AS rn FROM visible
)
SELECT COALESCE(r.statement_id, 0) AS statement_id, r.statement_type, r.title, r.message, r.policy_code, r.status,
       TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(r.created_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS created_at, TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(r.updated_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS updated_at, t.total
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM visible) t
LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.rn BETWEEN :start_row AND :end_row
ORDER BY r.rn
sql.update: UPDATE n_account_statements SET status = :status, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = :user_id AND statement_id = :statement_id
sql.readStatus: SELECT statement_id, status, TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(updated_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS updated_at FROM n_account_statements WHERE user_id = :user_id AND statement_id = :statement_id
sql.lock: SELECT status FROM n_account_statements WHERE user_id = :user_id AND statement_id = :statement_id FOR UPDATE
sql.pending: SELECT appeal_id, appeal_message FROM n_statement_appeals WHERE user_id = :user_id AND statement_id = :statement_id AND appeal_status = 'pending' ORDER BY appeal_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
sql.next: SELECT seq_statement_appeal_id.NEXTVAL AS id FROM dual
sql.insert: INSERT INTO n_statement_appeals (appeal_id, statement_id, user_id, appeal_message, appeal_status) VALUES (:appeal_id, :statement_id, :user_id, :appeal_message, 'pending')
